# Rule P1 (problem identity). OVERLAP_LANDED: a landed jdk.m3.algorithm method (families-20261106, graph-trie-20261106) answers the same catalogue problem; the answer may differ only in container or representation (int[] vs List, CSR int graph vs Map<V,..>, array tree vs Node<T>) and in the trailing M3ProgressMonitor. OVERLAP_OTHER_OWNER: no landed method does, another built M3JDK owner does with the same algorithm contract (jdk.m3.collections, java.base jdk.internal.m3, the cpu-tools module pack). ABSORB: neither. A derivable answer to a different question (count vs enumerate, exists vs locate, first vs every occurrence, BST by value vs node identity) is a different problem; named-algorithm entries (merge/heap/radix/counting sort, Fenwick, segment tree, sparse table, Manacher, Rabin-Karp, suffix array) compare by algorithm.
